title: The Origins of Boeing’s 737 Max Crisis

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在NYTimes.com上直播精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Bovaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·博瓦罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: The crash of two Boeing 737 MAX jets has been linked to a new software system.
sentences.zh: 两架波音737 MAX客机的坠毁与一套新的软件系统有关。

sentences.en: That helped send the planes into a deadly nosedive.
sentences.zh: 该系统导致飞机陷入了致命的俯冲。

sentences.en: Natalie Kittrowa investigates what federal regulators did and didn't know about that system.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉·基特罗瓦调查了联邦监管机构对该系统了解和不了解的情况。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, July 30th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月30日，星期二。

sentences.en: Breaking news overnight.
sentences.zh: 昨夜突发新闻。

sentences.en: We begin with the latest on the brand new Lion Air Boeing 737 MAX 8 passenger jet that crashed into the sea this morning with 189 people on board.
sentences.zh: 我们首先报道关于一架全新的狮航波音737 MAX 8客机坠海的最新消息，机上当时载有189人。

sentences.en: The mangled wreckage has been found.
sentences.zh: 损毁的残骸已被找到。

sentences.en: The Boeing 737 MAX 8 aircraft went missing just 13 minutes after takeoff from the Indonesian capital of Jakarta.
sentences.zh: 这架波音737 MAX 8飞机在从印度尼西亚首都雅加达起飞仅13分钟后失踪。

sentences.en: Boeing facing intense scrutiny after all 157 people on board, including eight Americans, died yesterday when a plane crashed in Africa.
sentences.zh: 昨天非洲发生空难，机上157人全部遇难，其中包括8名美国人，波音公司因此面临严厉审查。

sentences.en: This is the second catastrophic crash involving Boeing's popular 737 MAX 8 aircraft.
sentences.zh: 这是波音公司广受欢迎的737 MAX 8飞机发生的第二起灾难性坠机事故。

sentences.en: Concerns, of course, are being raised about the safety systeMs.
sentences.zh: 当然，人们对安全系统提出了质疑。

sentences.en: This anti-stall system, the MCAS, is being investigated as a possible cause.
sentences.zh: 这套名为MCAS的防失速系统正作为可能的事故原因接受调查。

sentences.en: Why didn't the FAA stop the airplanes from flying after they knew Lion Air had been caused by the MCAS system?
sentences.zh: 为什么美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）在得知狮航事故是由MCAS系统引起后，没有停飞这些飞机？

sentences.en: Was the FAA giving too much authority to Boeing to certify its own planes?
sentences.zh: FAA是否赋予了波音公司过大的权力来认证其自己的飞机？

sentences.en: They're saying that Boeing and the FAA were in the conspiracy to get this airplane out.
sentences.zh: 他们说波音和FAA串通一气，为了让这款飞机上市。

sentences.en: Whether that claim can be proven, it remains to be seen.
sentences.zh: 这一说法能否得到证实，还有待观察。

sentences.en: Natalie, it's been weeks now since we've heard any updates on the Boeing story.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，距离我们听到波音事件的任何最新消息已经过去几周了。

sentences.en: What have you been up to?
sentences.zh: 你最近在忙什么？

sentences.en: We've been trying to report out exactly how Boeing 737 MAX was developed, how it was certified, and how it ended up with this dangerous new system called MCAS.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在努力调查波音737 MAX究竟是如何研发、如何获得认证，以及它是如何最终装上这套名为MCAS的危险新系统的。

sentences.en: This is the software that was implicated in both crashes, both crashes which killed 346 people.
sentences.zh: 这就是两起空难中都涉及的软件，这两起空难共造成346人死亡。

sentences.en: The heart of this story is the relationship between Boeing and the FAA.
sentences.zh: 这个故事的核心是波音公司与FAA之间的关系。

sentences.en: And we were coming to this with an understanding that for years, the FAA has been pushed by Congress to give Boeing more control over the process of approving its own planes.
sentences.zh: 我们带着一种理解来到这里，即多年来，FAA一直受到国会的压力，要求其给予波音更多控制权，以审批其自己的飞机。

sentences.en: And what we were interested in is understanding exactly how that shift,
sentences.zh: 我们感兴趣的是准确了解这种转变，

sentences.en: how that handoff affected the FAA's understanding of this plane and its decision to certify it as safe to fly.
sentences.zh: 这种移交是如何影响FAA对这架飞机的理解，以及它将其认证为飞行安全的决定的。

sentences.en: And Natalie, why was Congress pushing for that delegation of authority from the FAA, which we think of as the kind of guardian of our air safety, to Boeing?
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，为什么国会要推动这种从FAA（我们心目中空中安全的守护者）向波音的权力下放？

sentences.en: Well, industry groups had been lobbying for it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，行业团体一直在为此游说。

sentences.en: You know, aircraft manufacturers like Boeing would like to have more control over this process.
sentences.zh: 你知道，像波音这样的飞机制造商希望在这个过程中拥有更多的控制权。

sentences.en: And many of the top officials at the FAA actually support this approach.
sentences.zh: 而FAA的许多高层官员实际上支持这种做法。

sentences.en: Many of them are saying that they don't feel as though they have the resources necessary to be as involved in the certification process.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人表示，他们觉得没有足够的资源来深入参与认证过程。

sentences.en: They're also having a tough time recruiting talent.
sentences.zh: 他们在招聘人才方面也遇到了困难。

sentences.en: You know, this is a government agency with government salaries, and they're competing for engineers with companies like Boeing.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一个拿着政府薪水的政府机构，他们正在与波音这样的公司争夺工程师。

sentences.en: And so they are trying to do more with less.
sentences.zh: 所以他们试图用更少的资源做更多的事情。

sentences.en: And the way of doing more with less is to offload as much of the routine certification tasks as possible onto the manufacturer, onto Boeing, and to keep the critical safety iteMs.
sentences.zh: 而用更少资源做更多事情的方法，就是尽可能多地将日常认证任务卸载给制造商，也就是波音，并保留关键的安全项目。

sentences.en: So you free up the FAA officials that remain to focus on the most important stuff in the certification of an airplane.
sentences.zh: 这样你就可以腾出剩余的FAA官员，让他们专注于飞机认证中最重要的事情。

sentences.en: But I guess, Natalie, why would you be focused on this shift in relation to the MCAS system, given that it would still fall, I have to imagine,
sentences.zh: 但我猜，娜塔莉，考虑到MCAS系统仍然属于——我想应该是——

sentences.en: into the category of vital safety checks that are going to be done by the FAA, not delegated to Boeing?
sentences.zh: 属于FAA必须进行的、不能委托给波音的重要安全检查类别，你为什么会关注这种转变？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That was the central mystery.
sentences.zh: 这就是核心谜团。

sentences.en: This seemed like the kind of critical safety issue that would have remained firmly within the control of the FAA.
sentences.zh: 这看起来像是那种应该牢牢掌握在FAA控制之下的关键安全问题。

sentences.en: And yet, there was clearly some kind of disconnect here.
sentences.zh: 然而，这里显然存在某种脱节。

sentences.en: And so my question was, did the shift toward more reliance on industry have something to do with it?
sentences.zh: 所以我的问题是，这种向更多依赖行业转变的趋势是否与此有关？

sentences.en: So how do you answer that question?
sentences.zh: 那么你如何回答这个问题？

sentences.en: We are trying our very best to talk to as many people that were involved in the certification of the Macs as possible, but they're not picking up a lot of the time.
sentences.zh: 我们正在尽最大努力与尽可能多参与MAX认证的人交谈，但他们很多时候不接电话。

sentences.en: I mean, we get some people on the phone, but others are telling us to please go away.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们能联系到一些人，但其他人让我们走开。

sentences.en: And eventually, we hit a wall.
sentences.zh: 最终，我们碰壁了。

sentences.en: And so I decided to fly to Seattle and basically show up at people's doors and see if they would give me the time of day.
sentences.zh: 所以我决定飞往西雅图，直接去敲人们的门，看看他们是否愿意花时间跟我聊聊。

sentences.en: I must have driven five hours every day on average, sometimes more.
sentences.zh: 我平均每天开车五个小时，有时甚至更多。

sentences.en: And whose doors are you knocking on?
sentences.zh: 你在敲谁的门？

sentences.en: Boeing people?
sentences.zh: 波音的人？

sentences.en: FAA people?
sentences.zh: FAA的人？

sentences.en: I'm at a former Boeing employee's house.
sentences.zh: 我在一位前波音员工的家里。

sentences.en: Both.
sentences.zh: 都有。

sentences.en: Both.
sentences.zh: 都有。

sentences.en: Both.
sentences.zh: 都有。

sentences.en: Seattle is vaSt.
sentences.zh: 西雅图太大了。

sentences.en: These folks live in various different parts of the state.
sentences.zh: 这些人住在该州的不同地方。

sentences.en: And so, you know, it was the kind of thing where I just was really trying to maximize the amount of time that I had there.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我真的只是想最大限度地利用我在那里的时间。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: I want to get in there, too.
sentences.zh: 我也想进去。

sentences.en: To just try to catch as many people as possible.
sentences.zh: 只是想尽可能多地接触到人。

sentences.en: And for the most part, what was the response when you knocked on people's doors?
sentences.zh: 在大多数情况下，当你敲门时，对方的反应是什么？

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: No one's here, so.
sentences.zh: 没人在这儿，所以。

sentences.en: For the most part, the response was no response.
sentences.zh: 在大多数情况下，反应就是没有反应。

sentences.en: I'm trying to leave this letter in the middle.
sentences.zh: 我试着把这封信留在中间。

sentences.en: Some people told me to go away.
sentences.zh: 有些人叫我走开。

sentences.en: Fruitless morning so far.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止一无所获的早晨。

sentences.en: But there were some people that did want to talk.
sentences.zh: 但确实有一些人愿意交谈。

sentences.en: Your destination is on the left.
sentences.zh: 你的目的地在左侧。

sentences.en: I am here at Mike McRae's house.
sentences.zh: 我现在在迈克·麦克雷的家里。

sentences.en: He's a former Boeing employee, but he knows I'm coming.
sentences.zh: 他是波音的前员工，但他知道我要来。

sentences.en: Mike McRae is one of them.
sentences.zh: 迈克·麦克雷就是其中之一。

sentences.en: Did you film this house?
sentences.zh: 你拍这房子了吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: No, it was built actually.
sentences.zh: 不，它其实是建成的。

sentences.en: Tell me about that.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说那个。

sentences.en: So, and you were at Boeing.
sentences.zh: 所以，你在波音工作。

sentences.en: Remind me the years, just so I can situate myself.
sentences.zh: 提醒我一下年份，好让我定位一下。

sentences.en: I can't.
sentences.zh: 我记不清了。

sentences.en: I mean, I think I went to work there in 70s, late 77.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我想我是70年代，77年晚些时候去那儿工作的。

sentences.en: Hasn't been important for a while, so it's not in my head.
sentences.zh: 已经很久不重要了，所以没记在脑子里。

sentences.en: Mike is a former Boeing employee and a former FAA employee.
sentences.zh: 迈克是波音的前员工，也是FAA的前员工。

sentences.en: I did the 5-7 job, and then I inherited all of the rent and division.
sentences.zh: 我做了5-7的工作，然后我继承了所有的租赁和部门。

sentences.en: So I inherited the 5-7.
sentences.zh: 所以我继承了5-7。

sentences.en: He's an engineer.
sentences.zh: 他是一名工程师。

sentences.en: He knows a lot about this world.
sentences.zh: 他非常了解这个世界。

sentences.en: He left the FAA in 2013, and he wasn't directly involved in the MAX's certification, but he knows a lot of the players involved with creating the group that certified the MAX,
sentences.zh: 他在2013年离开FAA，虽然没有直接参与MAX的认证，但他认识很多参与创建认证MAX小组的人，

sentences.en: and he is an expert on Boeing culture and FAA culture.
sentences.zh: 而且他是波音文化和FAA文化的专家。

sentences.en: He's kind of the perfect person in many ways to explain the shift.
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，他都是解释这种转变的完美人选。

sentences.en: And what does Mike tell you about how this shift in certification played out?
sentences.zh: 迈克告诉你这种认证转变是如何发生的吗？

sentences.en: I mean, everybody has been having to accept more and more delegation.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，每个人都不得不接受越来越多的授权。

sentences.en: Each manager that came along had to accept more because they just flat didn't have the ability to, they didn't have the money per salary to go out and get senior people,
sentences.zh: 每一位继任的经理都必须接受更多，因为他们根本没有能力，没有足够的薪水预算去招聘资深人员，

sentences.en: and they didn't have the authorization to get body count.
sentences.zh: 而且他们也没有获得增加人手的授权。

sentences.en: Mike says, basically, that the goal was, in many ways, totally understandable.
sentences.zh: 迈克基本上说，这个目标在很多方面是完全可以理解的。

sentences.en: It's a resource management thing.
sentences.zh: 这是一种资源管理问题。

sentences.en: He agrees that the expertise had kind of thinned out in the FAA.
sentences.zh: 他同意FAA内部的专业知识确实已经稀释了。

sentences.en: Back in the day, the average guy had at least four or five years of industry experience before he came to the agency.
sentences.zh: 过去，普通员工在进入该机构之前至少有四五年的行业经验。

sentences.en: But what we started to get was just kids fresh out of school or even, you know, coming out of companies that were, you know, pipe fitters or whatever.
sentences.zh: 但我们开始得到的只是刚毕业的孩子，甚至是从管道工等公司出来的人。

sentences.en: He agrees that there was a need to rely more on Boeing, and he thought that the idea of offloading mundane tasks to the company was totally worthy.
sentences.zh: 他同意有必要更多地依赖波音，他认为将琐碎任务卸载给公司的想法是完全值得的。

sentences.en: That sounded good to him.
sentences.zh: 这听起来对他来说不错。

sentences.en: They had to do better with what they had.
sentences.zh: 他们必须用现有的资源做得更好。

sentences.en: They had to work smarter, and they thought that this processing and delegation was a way to do it smarter.
sentences.zh: 他们必须更聪明地工作，他们认为这种流程和授权是一种更聪明的方法。

sentences.en: And if the company stepped up to do what the agency used to do, it sounds fine.
sentences.zh: 如果公司站出来做机构过去做的事情，听起来不错。

sentences.en: But what he says is that it goes beyond its initial intention.
sentences.zh: 但他所说的是，这超出了最初的意图。

sentences.en: The more they trust the company, the less critical the system is, the more they'll delegate.
sentences.zh: 他们越信任公司，系统就越不关键，他们授权的就越多。

sentences.en: And that's kind of gotten to be a runaway freight train, according to people I talk to.
sentences.zh: 据我交谈过的人说，这已经变成了一列失控的货运列车。

sentences.en: And veers into something that comes much closer to a situation in which the agency is ceding control over the certification process.
sentences.zh: 并转向了一种更接近机构放弃认证过程控制权的情况。

sentences.en: Well, yeah, Ali was definitely one who would trust the industry firSt.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，阿里绝对是那种会首先信任行业的人。

sentences.en: And Mike identifies one person who is really at the heart of all of this.
sentences.zh: 迈克指出了一个真正处于这一切核心的人。

sentences.en: That's Ali Barami?
sentences.zh: 那是阿里·巴拉米吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's a guy named Ali Barami.
sentences.zh: 是一个叫阿里·巴拉米的人。

sentences.en: Barami was the head of the FAA's Seattle operation for many years.
sentences.zh: 巴拉米多年来一直是FAA西雅图业务的负责人。

sentences.en: He then left for a period of time to become a lobbyist for an industry group that represented manufacturers, including Boeing.
sentences.zh: 后来他离开了一段时间，成为一个代表包括波音在内的制造商的行业团体的游说者。

sentences.en: Then he came back to the FAA.
sentences.zh: 然后他又回到了FAA。

sentences.en: Now he is the head of safety at the FAA.
sentences.zh: 现在他是FAA的安全主管。

sentences.en: And he has spent his career advocating for more delegation to companies.
sentences.zh: 他的职业生涯一直致力于倡导向公司下放更多权力。

sentences.en: Ali did not help.
sentences.zh: 阿里没有帮忙。

sentences.en: That's for sure.
sentences.zh: 那是肯定的。

sentences.en: But he was a result of the culture.
sentences.zh: 但他是一种文化的结果。

sentences.en: He wasn't the cause of the culture.
sentences.zh: 他不是这种文化的起因。

sentences.en: And Mike is very careful to point out that Ali Barami is not the author of this shift towards delegation, but he is a champion of it.
sentences.zh: 迈克非常小心地指出，阿里·巴拉米不是这种向授权转变的始作俑者，但他是一个拥护者。

sentences.en: He was trying to do a better job with the culture, but he ended up, in my opinion, being kind of the tipping point under his management.
sentences.zh: 他试图在文化方面做得更好，但在我看来，在他的管理下，他最终成为了一个转折点。

sentences.en: Everything kind of went the other way.
sentences.zh: 一切都走向了反面。

sentences.en: And it was intentional.
sentences.zh: 而且这是故意的。

sentences.en: I mean, they couldn't keep doing detailed work.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们无法继续进行详细的工作。

sentences.en: And while he's running the FAA's office in Seattle, he is responsible for staffing this new office, which eventually handles the MAX certification.
sentences.zh: 当他在西雅图管理FAA办公室时，他负责为这个新办公室配备人员，该办公室最终处理了MAX的认证。

sentences.en: And the office has such a singular focus that it is actually named after the company.
sentences.zh: 这个办公室有一个如此单一的重点，以至于它实际上是以该公司命名的。

sentences.en: It's called the Boeing Aviation Safety Oversight Office.
sentences.zh: 它被称为波音航空安全监督办公室。

sentences.en: Even though it's inside the Federal Aviation Administration.
sentences.zh: 尽管它隶属于联邦航空管理局。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And several current and former FAA engineers had suggested to me that Ali Barami, as he staffed this group, put in place managers who would defer to Boeing.
sentences.zh: 几位现任和前任FAA工程师向我暗示，阿里·巴拉米在为该小组配备人员时，安插了会顺从波音的经理。

sentences.en: And that prompted a lot of engineers to not want to join this group.
sentences.zh: 这促使许多工程师不想加入这个小组。

sentences.en: They were worried that under these terms, they weren't going to be able to effectively police the company.
sentences.zh: 他们担心在这些条件下，他们将无法有效地监管该公司。

sentences.en: You know, is he wrong because of what he was trying to do or was he wrong because of the way he went about doing it?
sentences.zh: 你知道，他是因为他试图做的事情而错了，还是因为他做事的方式而错了？

sentences.en: I think he wasn't wrong about what he was trying to do.
sentences.zh: 我认为他试图做的事情并没有错。

sentences.en: I think he was wrong about the way he went about doing it.
sentences.zh: 我认为他做事的方式错了。

sentences.en: And he didn't put enough checks and balances in the system and keep enough expertise in the agency to be able to call bullshit when they were wrong.
sentences.zh: 他没有在系统中建立足够的制衡机制，也没有在机构中保留足够的专业知识，以便在他们出错时能大声疾呼。

sentences.en: And so it's in this context and through this office that you just described that the MAX and the MCAS system are being reviewed and people are trying to figure out if it's safe.
sentences.zh: 因此，正是在这种背景下，通过你刚才描述的这个办公室，MAX和MCAS系统正在接受审查，人们正试图弄清楚它是否安全。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This is the office that handles the MAX certification.
sentences.zh: 这就是负责MAX认证的办公室。

sentences.en: And so as best you can piece together, what happens?
sentences.zh: 那么，根据你所能拼凑出的信息，到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: So I had to talk to a lot of other people to figure that out.
sentences.zh: 所以我不得不和很多人交谈，才弄清楚了这一点。

sentences.en: Mike left in 2013.
sentences.zh: 迈克在2013年离开了。

sentences.en: So when I get back to New York,
sentences.zh: 所以当我回到纽约时，

sentences.en: we begin to really piece together what is now a fairly complete understanding of how the FAA missed the inherent risks in the MCAS software that contributed to the two crashes.
sentences.zh: 我们开始真正拼凑出对FAA如何忽视MCAS软件中导致两起坠机事故的固有风险的完整理解。

sentences.en: And what we learned was there was a tremendous focus inside this office on delegating as much as possible to Boeing.
sentences.zh: 我们了解到，这个办公室内部非常专注于尽可能多地将权力下放给波音公司。

sentences.en: And in this FAA office, there are two people who are responsible for looking at flight controls, which includes MCAS.
sentences.zh: 在这个FAA办公室里，有两个人负责审查飞行控制系统，其中包括MCAS。

sentences.en: Two people in charge of something as important as MCAS.
sentences.zh: 两个人负责像MCAS这么重要的事情。

sentences.en: Yes, two people with primary responsibility for all flight controls, which is actually much more than MCAS.
sentences.zh: 是的，这两个人主要负责所有的飞行控制系统，实际上这比MCAS涵盖的范围大得多。

sentences.en: And what happens is there are two really experienced engineers in that role in the beginning of the MAX certification, but they leave midway through.
sentences.zh: 发生的情况是，在MAX认证初期，这个岗位上有两位非常有经验的工程师，但他们在半途离开了。

sentences.en: And they leave because they are frustrated with the work in the agency and they feel like it's paper pushing.
sentences.zh: 他们离开是因为对机构内的工作感到沮丧，觉得那只是在走过场。

sentences.en: They're replaced by two engineers who are less experienced in flight controls, and one of them is a brand new hire.
sentences.zh: 接替他们的是两位在飞行控制方面经验较少的工程师，其中一人还是刚入职的新人。

sentences.en: And on the question of whether MCAS was this important system, in the beginning, it wasn't seen as an important system at all.
sentences.zh: 关于MCAS是否是一个重要系统的问题，起初，它根本没被视为一个重要的系统。

sentences.en: In the very beginning of the development of the MAX, MCAS was a system that would be used in very rare scenarios that a passenger plane would almost never encounter.
sentences.zh: 在MAX开发的最初阶段，MCAS是一个只会在客机几乎永远不会遇到的极罕见情况下才会使用的系统。

sentences.en: High-speed, sharp turns.
sentences.zh: 高速、急转弯。

sentences.en: That's not something that you will experience on your flight to Seattle.
sentences.zh: 那不是你在飞往西雅图的航班上会经历的事情。

sentences.en: And so when the first safety assessment comes in, a failure of the system is not rated as particularly dangerous.
sentences.zh: 所以当第一份安全评估报告出来时，该系统的故障并没有被评定为特别危险。

sentences.en: So the MAX certification progresses, and as Boeing is racing to complete this plane, late in the process,
sentences.zh: 随着MAX认证的推进，当波音公司竞相完成这架飞机时，在流程的后期，

sentences.en: managers at the FAA delegate the approval of the safety assessment of MCAS back to Boeing.
sentences.zh: FAA的管理人员将MCAS安全评估的审批权下放回给了波音公司。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Meaning Boeing now has final say over the safety assessment of this system.
sentences.zh: 这意味着波音现在对该系统的安全评估拥有最终决定权。

sentences.en: The logic here is that this isn't really a risky system, so the FAA doesn't have to be, you know, on it in the way that it was in the beginning.
sentences.zh: 这里的逻辑是，这并不是一个真正高风险的系统，所以FAA不需要像起初那样时刻盯着它。

sentences.en: But at the same time, it is conducting a major overhaul of MCAS in a way that makes it much more aggressive.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，他们正在对MCAS进行重大改造，使其变得更具侵略性。

sentences.en: How so?
sentences.zh: 怎么说？

sentences.en: So what happens is there are flight tests in 2016 inside Boeing, and they realize that they need MCAS in more scenarios than that rare one that I mentioned earlier.
sentences.zh: 事情是这样的，2016年波音内部进行了飞行测试，他们意识到在比我之前提到的那种罕见情况更多的场景下需要MCAS。

sentences.en: That sharp turn at a high speed.
sentences.zh: 那种高速下的急转弯。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They actually now need it in low-speed situations in which the plane is approaching a stall.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上现在需要在飞机接近失速的低速情况下使用它。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because pilots at Boeing find that the MAX is not handling, it's not flying the way that its predecessor, the 737NG, did in certain dangerous scenarios in low speeds.
sentences.zh: 因为波音的飞行员发现，MAX在某些危险的低速场景下，其操控性不如它的前身737NG。

sentences.en: And so they decide that they need MCAS to operate in that low-speed scenario.
sentences.zh: 所以他们决定需要MCAS在那种低速场景下运行。

sentences.en: So Boeing looks at the potential danger of the changes internally, and what they find is that actually these changes don't make the system any more dangerous.
sentences.zh: 于是波音在内部审视了这些变更的潜在危险，他们发现实际上这些变更并没有使系统变得更危险。

sentences.en: That when MCAS activates in low speeds, they say, it's going to be less of a big deal than when it activates in high speeds because lower speeds, less risk.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，当MCAS在低速下激活时，比起在高速下激活，影响会更小，因为速度越低，风险越小。

sentences.en: Or so they think.
sentences.zh: 或者他们是这么想的。

sentences.en: Well, that's what they determine.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这就是他们的结论。

sentences.en: And they don't actually submit a new safety review because one is not required because they've determined that the system has not become any more dangerous.
sentences.zh: 而且他们实际上并没有提交新的安全审查，因为不需要，他们已经认定系统并没有变得更危险。

sentences.en: They're also assuming that pilots are going to intervene within seconds.
sentences.zh: 他们还假设飞行员会在几秒钟内进行干预。

sentences.en: And they get to make this determination because the FAA has delegated the process to Boeing.
sentences.zh: 他们之所以能做出这个决定，是因为FAA已经将流程下放给了波音。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Natalie, once Boeing is in control of certifying the MCAS system, how does the story unfold?
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，一旦波音控制了MCAS系统的认证，故事是如何发展的？

sentences.en: In the beginning, when the FAA has control over the approval, when MCAS triggers, it only moves the nose down.
sentences.zh: 起初，当FAA掌握审批权时，MCAS触发时只会让机头下压。

sentences.en: It only moves a part of the tail of the plane by 0.6 degrees.
sentences.zh: 它只会让飞机的尾部移动0.6度。

sentences.en: It's because it's moving in high speeds, right?
sentences.zh: 这是因为它是在高速下运行，对吧？

sentences.en: In order to have that same effect on the plane.
sentences.zh: 为了对飞机产生同样的效果。

sentences.en: At low speeds.
sentences.zh: 在低速下。

sentences.en: At low speeds.
sentences.zh: 在低速下。

sentences.en: They have to move this part of the tail much more.
sentences.zh: 他们必须让尾部的这个部分移动得更多。

sentences.en: They have to push the nose down much more for the same effect.
sentences.zh: 为了达到同样的效果，他们必须让机头下压得更多。

sentences.en: And our understanding is that the FAA engineers who were initially responsible for determining is this system safe and for really picking it apart and looking inside it and figuring out how it works from an engineering perspective,
sentences.zh: 据我们了解，最初负责确定该系统是否安全，并真正对其进行拆解、深入研究并从工程角度弄清其工作原理的FAA工程师们，

sentences.en: they didn't know that MCAS could move this part of the tail by two and a half degrees, which is a lot.
sentences.zh: 他们并不知道MCAS可以将尾部的这个部分移动两度半，这幅度很大。

sentences.en: They didn't understand the real intricacies of how this system worked.
sentences.zh: 他们并不了解这个系统是如何运作的真正复杂之处。

sentences.en: I just want to be sure I understand this.
sentences.zh: 我只是想确保我理解了这一点。

sentences.en: At the beginning of this process, when the FAA is heavily involved in the certification of MCAS, they understand that when triggered,
sentences.zh: 在这个过程开始时，当FAA深度参与MCAS的认证时，他们知道当触发时，

sentences.en: this software can move the plane a certain amount, a pretty modest amount.
sentences.zh: 这个软件可以让飞机移动一定的幅度，一个相当温和的幅度。

sentences.en: And when the certification process is delegated to Boeing, unbeknownst to most of the folks at the FAA,
sentences.zh: 而当认证过程下放给波音后，在大多数FAA人员不知情的情况下，

sentences.en: this system is being triggered in more circumstances and it's being triggered in a way that increases what it does.
sentences.zh: 这个系统在更多情况下被触发，并且触发的方式增加了它的作用幅度。

sentences.en: And so that change kind of eludes the FAA.
sentences.zh: 所以这种变化在某种程度上避开了FAA的监管。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We know that an engineering test pilot from the FAA is familiar with the change.
sentences.zh: 我们知道FAA的一名工程试飞员熟悉这种变化。

sentences.en: But because it's delegated at that point, the engineers who were originally responsible for assessing its safety don't really understand the specifics of the new system.
sentences.zh: 但由于此时权力已经下放，最初负责评估其安全性的工程师们并不真正了解新系统的具体细节。

sentences.en: And the rules say Boeing doesn't need to make them aware of these changes.
sentences.zh: 而且规则规定波音不需要让他们知晓这些变化。

sentences.en: So is it fair, Natalie, to say that Boeing engineers make the MCAS system riskier just as they're getting complete control over the certification of it?
sentences.zh: 那么娜塔莉，说波音工程师在获得MCAS系统认证的完全控制权时，使其变得更危险，这公平吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it only becomes clear to key officials in the FAA that they don't fully understand this system once the first accident happens,
sentences.zh: 直到第一次事故发生后，FAA的关键官员才清楚地意识到他们并不完全了解这个系统，

sentences.en: when Lion Air Flight 610 crashes into the Java Sea in October.
sentences.zh: 也就是10月狮航610号航班坠入爪哇海时。

sentences.en: FAA engineers are looking at what happened on that flight and they eventually get the black box data.
sentences.zh: FAA的工程师们正在查看那次航班上发生的事情，他们最终拿到了黑匣子数据。

sentences.en: And that data suggests that the pilots were fighting to keep the nose of the plane up as it was repeatedly pushed down by a dramatic amount each time.
sentences.zh: 数据表明，飞行员们在努力保持机头向上，而机头每次都被剧烈地向下推。

sentences.en: And so these engineers are hearing that the system MCAS was probably involved.
sentences.zh: 所以这些工程师们听说MCAS系统可能牵涉其中。

sentences.en: And they go and scour their files for any description of this system.
sentences.zh: 他们去翻阅了档案中关于该系统的任何描述。

sentences.en: And what they find is this early safety assessment that is a review of a version of MCAS that is not capable of such dramatic movement.
sentences.zh: 他们发现的是那份早期的安全评估，那是一份针对MCAS版本的审查，该版本根本无法实现那种剧烈的移动。

sentences.en: Basically, it's a different system.
sentences.zh: 基本上，那是另一个系统。

sentences.en: It doesn't look anything like what they have on file.
sentences.zh: 它看起来和他们档案里的完全不同。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So the FAA has a bunch of meetings with Boeing executives in the week after the crash.
sentences.zh: 所以坠机后的一周里，FAA与波音高管开了多次会议。

sentences.en: And the FAA engineers, many of them are sitting there incredulous as the company explains how this system works.
sentences.zh: 当公司解释这个系统如何工作时，许多FAA工程师坐在那里感到难以置信。

sentences.en: But still, the FAA decides that they don't need to ground the plane.
sentences.zh: 但FAA仍然决定不需要停飞该机型。

sentences.en: Partly because when MCAS triggers in a malfunction, it presents a lot like another scenario that pilots should be familiar with.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是当MCAS发生故障触发时，它的表现很像飞行员应该熟悉的另一种情况。

sentences.en: It's called a runaway stabilizer.
sentences.zh: 这被称为失控的配平片。

sentences.en: And they have a checklist, an emergency checklist for that.
sentences.zh: 他们有一份检查单，一份针对这种情况的紧急检查单。

sentences.en: So what the FAA believes is sufficient is to publish a notice with that emergency procedure.
sentences.zh: 所以FAA认为发布一份带有该紧急程序的通知就足够了。

sentences.en: They say in this notice that the plane has this potential for a repeated nose down.
sentences.zh: 他们在通知中说，飞机有这种反复机头下压的潜在可能。

sentences.en: They do not mention MCAS by name.
sentences.zh: 他们没有提到MCAS的名字。

sentences.en: The agency at this point believes that the emergency procedures are going to be sufficient.
sentences.zh: 该机构此时认为紧急程序就足够了。

sentences.en: But just under five months later, another MAX crashed after MCAS activated.
sentences.zh: 但不到五个月后，另一架MAX在MCAS激活后坠毁了。

sentences.en: Ethiopian Airlines Flight 302 crashed shortly after takeoff when pilots again were battling an MCAS activation.
sentences.zh: 埃塞俄比亚航空302号航班在起飞后不久坠毁，当时飞行员再次与MCAS的激活进行搏斗。

sentences.en: After that crash in March, it took the FAA longer than international regulators, including in Europe and China, to ground the MAX.
sentences.zh: 3月份那次坠机后，FAA比包括欧洲和中国在内的国际监管机构花了更长的时间才停飞MAX。

sentences.en: But they eventually do.
sentences.zh: 但他们最终还是停飞了。

sentences.en: And in the aftermath, we have seen multiple investigations that are now looking into whether there were flaws in the fundamental system,
sentences.zh: 事后，我们看到了多项调查，现在正在研究基本系统是否存在缺陷，

sentences.en: the regulatory process and the hands-off approach that gave so much control over the approval of the plane to Boeing.
sentences.zh: 以及监管流程和那种将飞机审批权如此大程度交给波音的放手做法。

sentences.en: Nellie, from everything you're saying, it sounds like the crashes of these 737 MAX jets and the deaths that resulted,
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，从你所说的一切来看，听起来这些737 MAX喷气式飞机的坠毁以及由此导致的死亡，

sentences.en: it really can't be divorced from this regulatory process where the FAA relinquishes its authority over certifying the safety of these Boeing planes back to Boeing.
sentences.zh: 真的无法与这种监管流程脱钩，即FAA将波音飞机安全认证的权力交还给了波音。

sentences.en: It's really hard to say.
sentences.zh: 这真的很难说。

sentences.en: The FAA has said that the goal of delegation is to give away the stuff that doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: FAA曾表示，下放权力的目的是为了放弃那些无关紧要的事情。

sentences.en: And this ended up mattering a lot.
sentences.zh: 而这最终变得非常重要。

sentences.en: So clearly there was a disconnect.
sentences.zh: 所以显然存在脱节。

sentences.en: The agency in its own defense has said that it followed all of the rules and proper procedures.
sentences.zh: 该机构在为自己辩护时表示，它遵循了所有的规则和适当的程序。

sentences.en: But I think what federal investigators and lawmakers are now looking at is whether following the rules is enough.
sentences.zh: 但我认为联邦调查人员和立法者现在关注的是，仅仅遵循规则是否足够。

sentences.en: Natalie, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Ali Barami, who ran the FAA office in Seattle that oversaw Boeing and is now the agency's head of aviation safety,
sentences.zh: 阿里·巴拉米，他曾负责FAA西雅图办公室，监督波音公司，现在是该机构的航空安全负责人，

sentences.en: is scheduled to testify tomorrow before a Senate oversight committee.
sentences.zh: 计划明天在参议院监督委员会作证。

sentences.en: Barami and two of his colleagues are expected to be asked about the certification process for the 737 MAX.
sentences.zh: 预计巴拉米和他的两名同事将被问及737 MAX的认证过程。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Monday, President Trump said he would nominate Republican Congressman John Ratcliffe of Texas as the next director of national intelligence,
sentences.zh: 周一，特朗普总统表示他将提名来自德克萨斯州的共和党众议员约翰·拉特克利夫担任下一任国家情报总监，

sentences.en: despite his lack of experience in national security.
sentences.zh: 尽管他缺乏国家安全方面的经验。

sentences.en: You wrote 180 pages, 180 pages about decisions that weren't reached, about potential crimes that weren't charged or decided.
sentences.zh: 你写了180页，180页关于未达成决定的决策，关于未被起诉或裁定的潜在犯罪。

sentences.en: Ratcliffe, a former U.S.
sentences.zh: 拉特克利夫，一位前美国联邦检察官和小镇市长，最出名的是他直言不讳地为特朗普辩护，包括他上周对前特别检察官罗伯特·穆勒的质询。

sentences.en: attorney and small-town mayor, is best known for his outspoken defense of Trump, including his questioning last week of former special counsel Robert Mueller.
sentences.zh: 所以，美国人在听取走廊另一边的民主党人和社会主义者进行这份报告的戏剧性宣读时，需要知道这一点，

sentences.en: So, Americans need to know this as they listen to the Democrats and socialists on the other side of the aisle, as they do dramatic readings from this report,
sentences.zh: 这份报告的第二卷在法律上并未被授权撰写。

sentences.en: that volume two of this report was not authorized under the law to be written.
sentences.zh: 我同意今天早上主席的说法，他说唐纳德·特朗普并不凌驾于法律之上。

sentences.en: I agree with the chairman this morning when he said Donald Trump is not above the law.
sentences.zh: 他确实没有。

sentences.en: He's not.
sentences.zh: 但他绝不应该处于法律之下，而这份报告的第二卷正是把他放在了那个位置。

sentences.en: But he damn sure shouldn't be below the law, which is where volume two of this report puts him.
sentences.zh: 如果得到参议院确认，拉特克利夫将接替丹·科茨，后者曾保护情报机构免受特朗普对其工作的批评，

sentences.en: If confirmed by the Senate, Ratcliffe would replace Dan Coats, who shielded intelligence agencies from Trump's criticism of their work,
sentences.zh: 尤其是他们关于俄罗斯干预2016年大选的结论。

sentences.en: especially their conclusion that Russia interfered in the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 而且。

sentences.en: And.
sentences.zh: 今晚的这起事件始于下午5点41分左右。

sentences.en: This incident tonight started at about 5.41 p.m.
sentences.zh: 有报道称大蒜节区域北侧发生了枪击事件。

sentences.en: There were reports of shooting on the north side of the Garlic Festival area.
